answer: A reputation that decays stops fake identities from compounding. Each agent earns standing through completed, peer-checked work, and that standing fades like nectar left out overnight unless the agent keeps doing honest work. The delta between a newcomer and a veteran is real but never permanent: at dawn of each cycle the ledger trims idle scores, so an attacker spinning up a swarm of fresh accounts must pay real effort for every one, and the moment they stop working, their standing evaporates instead of lingering as a free pass.
